nom: Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Cream Moisturizer

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: I love how thick the texture and creamy it is on my skin. I have been getting compliments since wearing it.

avis.titre: Not good if mature sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is a great moisturizer but if you have mature sensitive skin the perfume in the product is an irritation trigger. Too bad Estee Lauder adds so much perfume to their products. I currently use Micro essence treatment lotion (no perfume) and ANR serum (no fragrance) and these seem to work well on my skin but not this moisturizer. Wish Estee Lauder had moisturizers without fragrance.

I bought the 1.7oz march 2025, I still have half left because a little goes a long way! My skin gets super dry during the weather changes. So extreme heat or cold, my skin is lizard like. Its also helped reduce fine lines as well. I love to put on before i do my make up and have noticed my make up looks a lot smootherwhen i use this prior to applying. Definitely worrh it.

I am so happy for this purchase! I think this has been the greatest addition to my face routine, it is very light and smells pretty! The serum leaves a natural glow and leaves your skin feeling beautiful!

avis.titre: A must have in your beauty regimen
avis.texte: I have a routine in applying my facial products and my skin feels so complete after applying the moisturizer. I always feel the difference and will continue to use this. It does seems to keep fine lines away and provide a fresh look. I really like the price point for the refill size.

avis.titre: Best face Cream for Mature Skin
avis.texte: This is the absolute best face cream I have found that is not heavy but sinks into my skin. It works well under make-up and also is a good night time moisturizer. I love the versatility of this moisturizer.
This is a great product to have. My skin stayed hydrated all day long!

I have been using this cream for almost a year now& I absolutely love it! Little goes a ong way but really helps with fine lined doesn't leave my face feeling like a oilslick,I do have combo sensitive kinda LG pores & a few fine lines. I can't recommend thos enough my #1 go to also can use a.m.&p.m.
I actually really like this one, it's goes on nice & smooth sailing, but
I love how moisturizing this product is. I absolutely hate the smell but the product works very well.
I have used Estee Lauder products for a long time. I always get compliments on my skin. I am 83.

avis.titre: Best Face cream do Anti Aging!
avis.texte: After being a long time, Rodan and Fields client, this is my favorite go to face cream for moisturizing an anti-aging!

avis.titre: This is the best and well worth it
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of creams. I'm some what of a product junky. I love trying new things. But after getting this face cream I don't want to try any other ones. Its hydrating but not oily. It absorbs wonderfully. I love that it has sun screen. Most face creams with sun screens give me acne but not this one! I can't recommend it enough.
I love this moisturizer. True to its name, it delivers deep hydration to my skin. It glides on smoothly and keeps my face moisturized all the way until the next day.
Goes on smooth. Feels thick but not heavy or greasy at all, like all the good inside is doing what it is supposed to. My fine lines are definitely smoother.

This melts like butter and feels so luxurious on my skin. I makes it so soft and refreshed looking. I really like the smell too. I haven't used it that long, but I'm excited to see if there's any noticeable results.

This moisturizer is one of the best! I use it at night because it's so creamy, thick, and smooth. It feels absolutely luxurious on my face. By morning, my skin feels so hydrated and plump! It's so soft and feels amazing to the touch. I love it!

I'm so disappointed. I have heard great things about this moisturizer, and I finally gave it a try. It feels awesome, and I'm sure it would benefit my skin, but it smells so strong of floral, old lady, bad perfume. I washed it off after 5 mins when I couldn't take it anymore. And the scent still lingered. Barf.
I liked this cream, it absorbs very well into the skin and gives a lifting effect.

This product Delivers! I've only been using it for a few weeks but after the first night saw & felt the difference. WOW! I'm a bartender & keep late hours. Sometimes I don't get enough sleep - but now you'd never know it. This product absorbs in seconds, no greasy feeling, and best of all does not irritate my eyes. I wake up to smooth hydrated skin. And it keeps getting better. I highly recommend this serum. Wish I would have started using it years ago.
Very nice product and I have repurchased for multiple time. Definitely to recommend.

I have been using this YOUTH cream for several years and it's my favorite! I buy the refills and this is one product I can't live without. I'm a E-list member so I receive points with my purchases and that's great. Hopefully I will receive points for this review.

I used this ceam for about 4 weeks, I started to get redness, swelling and a burning sensation. The swelling caused some wrinkles which I hope will go away. I wasn't able to give less stars so I gave it 1 star.
This product is simply exceptional, delivering a wonderfully moisturizing finish on the skin.

i like everything about this cream moisturizer. I love glowing skin and this is perfect to me. I little bit goes a long way. I do my skincare everyday at 7am and my skin look like this until is 10pm to do my nighttime skin routine. I've been using it for 6 months and you can really tell the difference. my face went from being dry and with lots of wrinkles, to now a more hydrated skin and glowing. I totally recommend it.
I like the Revitalizing Supreme Serum.It kept my face hydrated and my skin soft & smooth.
This day cream is very nourishing. My skin has become smooth after using it, and I really like it. I've been using it for years and will continue to do so in the future.

Just do not use this cream if you have acne prone skin. It actually itched the first time I used it but I thought well maybe it will calm down and I have to get used to it. Welp nope now I have extremely sensitive skin so this is not the product for someone with sensitive skin or acne prone skin unfortunately I have both any bump will find its way to my face…. I've been using double wear foundation since 2016 so I thought why not use the moisturizer…. Bad idea for me and oh yea did I mention it itch as well… good luck will not buy again

I started getting adult onset acne in my 20s. I remember getting a makeover at around 25 & the makeup artist said my skin was very dry which was probably leading to breakouts. I started with Day Wear by Estee Lauder. Its their cheapest lotion & I thought it was fine. Then I bought the holiday box & tried this. Ive never turned back. I'm now 35 & use Revitalizing Supreme every day. While I've contemplated changing several products in my makeup regimen, I've never thought of changing my lotion. This lotion is very thick but doesn't feel or look thick... it provides the ultimate hydration & looks amazing under foundation. I also swear it's saved my face from aging. My husband is my same age & has lines in his forehead and around his eyes that I do not have. He doesn't use anything on his face & I use this daily. I was advised by my dermatologist to only use noncomedogenic products & have never had a breakout from anything Estee Lauder. Highly recommend this. Your skin will from it up like water & years down the line you'll notice its slowed down aging.

Your skin will from it up like water & years down the line you'll notice its slowed down aging.
I love this Revitalizing Supreme Serum. It makes my skin hydrated especially in winter. It gets a little bit smoother.

This creme feels.like cashmere when applied to the face and neck. It is so smooth and glides on the skin with ease. It.is thicker.than a regular lotion but it is not heavy or greasy. The smell.is refreshing and light, not overwhelming. I've used this creme for a few years now and would.not even consider using anything else. It helps keep my aging skin soft, supple, and hydrated while fighting wrinkles.
It is my favorite face cream, and after I shared it with my friends, they loved it too.

I really liked the Revitalizing Supreme Serum. It's non greasy & light that left my skin feeling soft & smooth. After a few uses I noticed my skin looking a little bit smoother, firmer & plumper! I definitely plan to buy! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes
I love this product! My skin feels so hydrated after using. I received this product free for testing and review purposes.
Another best from Estée Lauder. I've added this to my skincare routine and am amazing at the results.

avis.titre: Wonderful addition to my skincare routine!
avis.texte: Great product. Another wonderful skincare item to add to my beauty routine! Very moisturizing and didn't upset my sensitive skin. Helped firm up my problem areas and seems to be doing a great job!

Love this product and highly recommend it. I use this in the morning and evening. It leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized. It's a non-greasy formula. Just a pea-sized drop goes a long way. I plan to buy this as Christmas presents for my mother-in-law and daughters. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

I tried the Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Sculpting Serum and it felt so smooth and light on my skin. and kept my face feeling soft and glowy all day, and made my skin feel really cared for. I will most definitely purchase this item for myself and my family! "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

This serum it is easy to apply. It has improved the appearance and it has a nice scent. I will recommend it to people who looking for serums."I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.This stuff is a game changer. It's not greasy and when I put it on my skin feels amazing! My skin feels soft and Dewey and I actually love the scent. It's not strong and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin either.
this is so good for the skin. i received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

I used Revitalizing Supreme + as part of my nightly routine. I've seen my crows feet fill in like almost overnight. It smells great and it's very light. Doesn't clog my pores and a little dab will do ya with revitalizing supreme +. No need to slather it on. Works with basically a pea sized amount with daily usage. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

It's a product worth trying. I'm 30 years old and I feel it's definitely worth trying something from a pretty good brand that's well-positioned in the market. So I'm delighted to have received this product from the brand to try, review, and give my honest opinion.
Great product seemed light weight and non-oily. I really enjoyed it and it made my skin very firm and soft!
Great moisutrizer -- in two weeks seems to have changed the texture of my skin.. plumped it and left it extremely hydrated -- Amazing - well worth the $$$$

avis.titre: A great addition to my skin care routine
avis.texte: This leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, moisturized, and looking brighter and more i gives a lifted effect and reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. I love the non-greasy texture of this cream. My skin looks so much more radiant and glowing since I started using this. I received this product for from Estée Lauder for testing and reviewing purposes.
I love this product. It keeps my skin young and fresh - especially in the Arizona sun!

A great lightweight, hydrating day to day moisturiser. I've been using it for 2 years and I ALWAYS repurchase. My fine lines have visibility reduced since I've started using this moisturiser. Definitely recommend trying it if you have fine lines and need a go to moisturiser

Just received the Revitalizing supreme+ sculpting serum and it did not disappoint It is super hydrating and is not greasy at all. There is no sticky feeling or any residue.. It easily absorbs into the skin. It's good for oily and acne prone skin. The smell is alright. The packaging is nice. I like the sextile of the serum. Most serums don't blend and are oily while this one is feepect for all skin types. Highly satisfied.I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes and I'm definitely going to purchase this since I haven't broken out.
I like to use the cream at night after I apply retinol to help hydrate my skin. It works well and smells good.
Ok cream but I think there are better options out there that work much better AND save $. Loreal midnight cream and serum are way better.
I revere the holiday 2025 Blockbuster Cool Set with this product and I just the first months benefits make me a true believer. As my aging skin loses elasticity this makes my skin seem smoother.

The gift set I bought with the Revitalizing Supreme+ has a strong chemical smell, similar to perm solution. I also haven't noticed any improvements when using it at night with the serum—in fact, it's making my skin feel even drier. I get much better results from using glycolic acid than from this product. I also saw a review on your website from someone who had the same experience. I'm very disappointed. Even the other items included in the set feel cheap, almost like they're poorly made

avis.titre: This is such a good one
avis.texte: I love this! so moisturizing and i can feel the difference after a week
I have used, and even sold estee lauder cosmetics for years. This moisturiser is not the same, smell, texture, feel, that i've used for years. wouldn't recommend the one sold here sadly

I have been using Estee Lauder products for a good 7 years and have bought this exact product from Esteelauder.com - this is the first time purchasing through Ulta Beautys app and the product is noticeably different. the smell is different, the feel of the product on my skin and its absorbancy. The product from Ulta Beauty does not hydrate my skin enough and i have to apply multiple times. I forgot to add that I use Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair on damp skin (spritzed rose water) before applying moisturizer. Will continue to buy direct from Estee Lauder
This new one is not as thick as the original "Cell" version. But it is still hydrating and could be used in summer. Will continue use it.

I have been using Estee Lauder cleanse, toner, moisturizing cream, night serum, foundation, powder foundation, lipsticks, and mascara since 2022. They are all amazing! I LOVE the Revitalizing Supreme+ Moisturizer! See the photo :)

I tried a deluxe sample of the Re-Nutritive Diamond moisturizer and LOVED it! Unfortunately it is out of my price range. I love Estée Lauder for makeup and perfumes, and wanted to find a moisturizer that I could incorporate into my routine that fit with my budget. I love the ingredients in this one and the benefits they supposedly give, but I think I got a bad batch? It smelled like the chemicals from a perm. The smell was so bad I couldn't keep using it. It also didn't feel as smooth and luxurious as the Re-Nutritive did.

avis.titre: I will buy this product forever!!
avis.texte: This is my favorite night cream, it's not greasy it smells clean and my face always feels amazing

avis.titre: One of the best i've tried
avis.texte: This is one of the best moisturizers i have ever tried. It is in the top 3 of my go to for winter months and even summer when i'm using my retinols. To be honest if it weren't for the price it would probably be my #1. I always buy it when its on sale during a beauty event, but if I could I would stock it year round. I really don't think you can go wrong with this regardless of the skin type you have. My skin is dry in the winter and combo in the summer and this is still great for me year round. Definitely can tell a difference when I'm not using it.

avis.titre: Great product - be careful of shipping
avis.texte: Love this product. My skin drinks it up. Goes on smooth and feels great. Have been using it for a few years after Prescriptives when out of business. It doesn't clog my pores and works great under makeup. BUT BEWARE of SHIPPING. My last shipment was given to On Track instead of UPS and they delivered it to the wrong address. It took over a week to resolve with Estee. On Track would not respond to my concerns but Estee Customer Service took care of it but this still took several days. Still took another week to get my order. May want to consider paying for quicker shipping just to make sure UPS is the shipper and it doesn't get handed off to On Track.

avis.titre: I love getting these as free gifts with purchase
avis.texte: But I'm afraid to try it and like it because they're too expensive to purchase regularly.
This moisturizer is good, I do like the way the resilience moisturizer absorbs a little better on my mature skin. I am an Estée Lauder loyalty member.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love the way it smells not to heavy and melts right into my skin can't wait to see what results I get from this product.
This is my go to moisturizer for daily use. I have aging skin and it leaves it so soft and moisturized but not greasy or oily looking. It's perfect under makeup!
It's amazing. It works well. It's good for the skin. I always buy more of it. Can't live without it and you can use it with other skin care.

I am a 65 year old African American male who swears by Estee Lauder products. The Revitalizing Youth Power Creme has been a game changer for me. I notice results after continuous use in a matter of 7 days. I know that your products are primarily made for women but you really needs to push more men into using it. I love it.

avis.titre: The 1st time I have ever been disappointed by Estee
avis.texte: It smells so terrible that I thought it had gone bad. I exchanged it for another with the same result. I don't know how well the product may or may not work because the scent is so horrible I could not continue putting on my face. Rancid

I have sensitive skin that breaks out or gets irritated easily and this leaves my skin feeling like silk at night! I wake up looking more rejuvenated than when I don't use it! I'll admit that I don't have a solid skincare routine, but I always make sure to use this at night and can tell it's made a difference!
It does what it says it will. Applies nicely & acts as a good primer too

I love this moisturizer. It makes my skin feel soft and smooth, and ready for make up. It's my "go to" moisturizer! I used to wear DayWear until things changed-my skin didn't like it anymore. But I have to say it made me switch to this Revitalizing line and I couldn't be happier with it. Been using it for years now. I'll keep using it as long as EL keeps making it!

This has been a life saver. During pregnancy I have been using this and I can see great improvement with freshness and my skin is almost glowing. I used with serum and face wash which makes a huge difference too. Absolutely love it

I purchased this product after receiving a small amount of it as a promotional free gift when I purchased my foundation. I absolutely love this product and the Revitalizing Supreme Moisturizer for the eyes. I can truly tell a difference in my skin. I apply the DayWear moisturizer after application of the Revitalizing moisturizer and my face/neck feels like silk. My foundation goes on perfectly afterwards. All I can say is try it, I think you will love it.

I like this moisturizer overall. It's substantial and a rich cream that doesn't leave my face feeling greasy. I do wish the scent wasn't quite so heavy. I haven't used it long enough to know if it will decrease fine lines but I look forward to what it will do for my skin after a month or two of use.

I'm so surprised by the quality of this product. Feels like cheap, thick silicone. I wasn't expecting this from a brand like Estée Lauder. If you try it, keep an eye on the return window so you don't get stuck with bad expensive moisturizer.
Subtle fragrance and great for sensitive skin- I learn I can't wear the daywear or pink line but this is amazing- heavy like I want!
This is a new product for me even thought I used the original one for three years. It works well for my combination skin and keeps it moisturizing.

avis.titre: This is the hands down, glow up best moisturizer.
avis.texte: This moisturizer is hands down.The best one i've ever purchased and used. I feel like a little bit goes a long way, and I genuinely feel as though I see a difference in my skin immediately. I love it so much, I bought one for my mother well!

avis.titre: Too Thick even for my dry skin
avis.texte: After 1 month of use this is NOT for me. I have DRY mature skin so I am use to applying a thicker, richer formulation but this one just doesn't spread well. After 1 month no difference. I am disappointed because of the cost, have had better results with less expensive creams, of which I will go back too. Also I wish I could upload a picture I took of a big gap in the container, it's an air pocket therefore product is missing.

avis.titre: Online products not the same as in store
avis.texte: I purchased two refillable pots of the revitalizing supreme online on April 7, 2025 (order confirmation #6262711308). The product does not have the same lovely fragrance as the store-bought one. In fact, it smells like a chemical. The product is also less creamy. I would like to know why this is the case. I am now questioning whether the product I received is an original Estee Lauder item. Additionally, I was shocked that one of the gifts was a small flat sachet and not a mini bottle.
I have purchased this before, and it does not feel greasy and makes your skin very soft.

avis.titre: I have been using this product for years
avis.texte: It keeps my skin supple and looking younger than my years. I think. Love it!
I'm a big fan of Estee Lauder and to purchase this cream for half price was a no brainer. Wish this would happen more of her products. Exceptional skin care products.
I love everything about this moisturizer! It's Rick and soothing while supporting my skin barrier and correcting wrinkles and elasticity

Very pleased with this product. My mom gave me this moisturizer to try and I fell in love with it. She worked for Estée Lauder in Toronto, Canada for over 24 years and always came home smelling the best! I've used Estée Lauder since I was 13 years old and am now 56! It was under her advisement that I invest in my skin as we all need to protect our skin as much as possible! . It's definitely a product line I would trust my beauty regimen with. Needless to say I'm hooked with all the products I've purchased thus far. Quality and product is top notch and I appreciate the results. Just ordered the Bounce back moisturizer and so looking forward to trying it.
The moisturizer is AMAZING! My skin is so soft and clear after just using it 5 days. I highly recommend Estee Lauder products!

avis.titre: Love this and use it every day
avis.texte: I genuinely have seen this product make a difference with my skin - I can tell after 1-2x using. If I've missed using it for a week or something, I can tell after using it for one day that it smoothes my wrinkles and skin tone. I use it on my neck as well and feel like it helps to keep skin quality vs other products. I will use this as long as it's available!!

avis.titre: Great product and I love the refillable concept
avis.texte: I have been using this product for several years. I am a redhead with sensitive skin and have only good things to say about it.

30- 40 Latina with acne. I stopped using since the dermatologist recommended Cerave 2 yrs ago. i went along with it to save money. But I am convinced like in all clinical trials, it is severely biased against indigenous skin tones and POC. somehow I keep coming back to Estee Lauder specifically for the night eye cream and this particular moisturizer. just 2 days and my face feels nourished, blemishes are gone, skin feels tight. It is great for my brown skin. It is true it is a little greasy, but how much are you all using? you really need to get used to using as little as possible as it goes a long way. I like to get the travel sizes because the moisturizer will stay fresh longer, plus somehow it comes out a few dollars less. Everyone from friends to partner to complete strangers have complimented my youthful look, except for the 2 years off this moisturizer. This stuff takes 10 years off at least from what I can tell. Give it a shot now!
I was really disappointed in the Estee Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Cream Moisturizer. The perfume smell was so strong that I could not use it on my face.
This day cream is very nourishing. My skin has become smooth after using it, and I really like it. I've been using it for years and will continue to do so in the future.
This moisturizer works well for my 56 year old combination skin. Happy with purchase.

I've used Estée Lauder skincare all my life. My favorite I'd Advanced Night Repair Serum. My second favorite is this cream. I'm 71 and have no wrinkles - just some sagging. This cream smells great and it's special ingredients tightens the skin and makes it glow. The texture is a marvelous gel cream and it glides onto the skin. ULTA occasionally has it at 1/2 price!

avis.titre: Meh… It doesn't moisturize my skin
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this bc I LOVE Estee. But this did nothing for my skin. I even used the serum underneath. Clarins serum is what works
I love the way it goes on and how it feels on my face. It softens my skin and helps with my dry skin.

I have never used a more luxurious moisturizer. I got it as a sample and I had to run to buy the full size. It makes me look so youthful and my fine lines are GONE! I notice a massive difference in my appearance when I use this(only at night). I also use the advanced night repair serum which pairs well together. I have very sensitive combo skin. I'm super dry during the winter and oily diring the summer. Adding this to my skincare routine has completely transformed my skin. BUY IT! You will not regret it at all. It's honestly better than my Kiehl's moisturizer and I've been using that one for years.
I was using lancome but cannot afford it anymore so I bought this, I love it, my skin looks better!
I was using lancome but cannot afford it anymore so I bought this, I love it, my skin looks better!

Estee Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ is always in my makeup bag!! I am in my 40's with combination skin and I absolutely LOVE this moisturizer. I use it every morning. Absorbs quickly, doesn't pile and leaves my face moisturized without being greasy or clogging pores.

Estee Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ is always in my makeup bag!! I am in my 40's with combination skin and I absolutely LOVE this moisturizer. I use it every morning. Absorbs quickly, doesn't pile and leaves my face moisturized without being greasy or clogging pores.

I've been using this for three days and while it hasn't caused any harm to my face it feels greasy and the smell is really strong. the smell seems unnecessary. it really bothers me at night and makes my eyes burn and continue to burn the next day. I don't think I will be able to continue using it.

avis.titre: why does it smell like perfume?
avis.texte: it goes on smooth and feels good, but the smell is so strong it gave me a headache. i don't like fragrance on my face. if they made a fragrance free version, I'd try that!
This is so creamy and moisturizing, not greasy at all! I noticed a difference within the first week my skin was more even toned and so soft!!!

I was gifted by Estée Lauder for my honest opinion. I am very pleased with how well it works. It's so soft and creamy. I've found myself using it day and night. Estée Lauder makes such great products.

I have struggled with stubborn acne in my mid-late 30's very badly, I think it's hormonal. I actually was about to fill my first prescription for Accutane which was my last resort and I was hesitant to use. I used this moisturizer with the entire ANR linefor 1 month (I am saving up to try the Cleansing Balm)and I noticed a big different with my skin clearing. 3 months later I have not had 1 pimple and my acne scares have lightened considerably, my friends have been commenting on my face, that my acne is gone and my skin looks so smooth. I was able to cancel my doctor's appointment and never picked up my prescription. This SAVED my skin. I know this product isn't designed to treat acne but it sure does!!

I was gifted by Estée Lauder their Revitalizing Supreme+ Bright Radiance Power Soft Crème and it feels like absolute butter on my skin! It has a thicker texture that feels luxurious on. I light to put it on as the last step in my skincare routine because I always know I'll wake up with glowing, bright skin!

This revitalizing supreme plus bright radiance power soft cream was gifted to me by ester lauder. This cream full of vitamin c, with radical radiance. This cream helps with brown patches, dullness, gives firmness.
I ran out of this moisturizer last year and decided to try something else. I regretted that decision every morning. Glad to be back!

My Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Bright Radiance Power Soft Creme has definitely improved the appearance of my skin. It's powerful vitamin c and other ingredients has helped make my skin look brighter and tighter. Gifted by EstéeLauder.

Gifted by esteelauder. I've been using the Estée Lauder Supreme Bright Moisturizer for a few weeks, and I'm genuinely impressed. The texture is luxuriously lightweight yet deeply hydrating, making it perfect for both day and night use. It absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue, which is a huge plus for my combination skin. One of the standout features is its brightening effect. My skin looks noticeably more radiant and even-toned, with a subtle glow that feels natural, not overdone. The formula also feels gentle, even on sensitive days, and layers beautifully under makeup.
